tools.name: swarm.plan
tools.description: Plan a bounded multi-agent swarm without spawning work.

sandbox.reason: Planning does not execute child agents but is still policy-relevant.

tools.name: swarm.spawn
tools.description: Create a bounded swarm record for delegated work.

sandbox.reason: Spawning multiple agents is policy-gated and bounded by the swarm manifest.

tools.name: swarm.delegate
tools.description: Delegate a task to a bounded swarm agent record.

sandbox.reason: Delegation is policy-gated and remains inside the declared swarm.

tools.name: swarm.join
tools.description: Join a bounded swarm and return a summary.

tools.name: swarm.cancel
tools.description: Cancel a bounded swarm and all tracked child agent records.

sandbox.reason: Cancellation only mutates plugin-owned swarm state.
